51307597.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal Avitag-fused His6-tagged USP5 ZnF-UBD (unknown origin) (171 to 290 residues) labelled with 5-fluorotryptophan expressed in BL21 (DE3) Codon Plus RIL Escherichia coli incubated for 35 to 60 secs by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: Surface Plasmon Resonance. Studies were performed using a Biacore T200 (GE Health Sciences). Approximately 4000–6000 response units (RU) of biotinylated USP5171–290, FL USP5WT 1–835, and FL USP5R221A 1–835 was coupled to flow cells of a SA chip per manufacturer’s protocol, and an empty flow cell used for reference subtraction. Two-fold serial dilutions were prepared in 20 mM Heps pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% Tween-20 (v/v), and 1% DMSO (v/v). Kd determination experiments were performed using multicycle kinetics with 35–60 s contact time, and 30 μL/min flow rate at 20 °C. Kd values were calculated using steady-state affinity fitting with the Biacore T200 evaluation software.
original_paragraph.Figure 1 caption: Figure 1. Characterization of USP5 ZnF-UBD interactions: (a) crystal structure of USP5 ZnF-UBD (grey) in complex with a C-terminal ubiquitin peptide (cyan) (PDB: 2G45). The Trp side chains of USP5 are highlighted. (b) 19F NMR spectra of 5FW-USP5 ZnF-UBD before (blue) and after the addition of LRLRGG ubiquitin peptide (red) (at 6-fold excess) (c) 19F NMR spectra of 5FW-USP5 ZnF-UBD before (blue) and after the addition of compound 5 (at 25-fold excess) (d) SPR sensogram and binding curve of LRLRGG ubiquitin peptide (left) and compound 5 (right).
original_paragraph.Figure 1d sensorgram data: Figure 1d shows SPR sensograms and binding curves. The left panel shows the binding curve for LRLRGG ubiquitin peptide with a Kd of 52 ± 2 μM. The right panel shows the binding curve for compound 5 with a Kd of 220 ± 23 μM. The x-axis for the binding curve of compound 5 is labeled '[compound 5] (μM)' and ranges from 0 to 1000 μM. The sensorgrams show association and dissociation phases over a time range of 0 to 60 seconds.
original_paragraph.Table 1: Table 1. SPR Kd and Ligand Efficiency of Preliminary Hit Compounds. Compound 5 has a Kd of 220 ± 23 μM and an LE of 0.33. The table includes compounds 1-11, with compound 5 being one of the preliminary hits.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Figure 5. Representative SPR sensogram and binding curve of compound 21 with (a) USP5 ZnF-UBD (b) WT FL USP5.
original_paragraph.Figure 5a sensorgram data: Figure 5a shows the SPR sensogram and binding curve for compound 21 with USP5 ZnF-UBD. The binding curve shows a Kd of 60 ± 8 μM. The x-axis for the binding curve is labeled '[compound 21] (μM)' and ranges from 0 to 1000 μM. The sensorgram shows association and dissociation phases over a time range of 0 to 100 seconds.
original_paragraph.Figure 5b sensorgram data: Figure 5b shows the SPR sensogram and binding curve for compound 21 with WT FL USP5. The binding curve shows a Kd of 84 ± 37 μM.
